issues.description:
npm pack --json output parsed via stdout.indexOf('['); if prepack build output ever writes a '[' to stdout before the JSON, parsing fails (reported as a named 'pack' failure, not silent). Prefer locating the JSON array more robustly (e.g. lastIndexOf('
[') or parse from the first line that equals '[').

Cleanup only runs through fail() and the success path; an unexpected thrown exception (e.g. readFileSync/JSON shape error such as entry.files undefined) leaves the temp dir behind. A try/finally around the body would make cleanup unconditional.

Intermediate commit 98352fa is not green: workflow.test.ts smoke-pack assertions were committed before the job existed (RED). This follows the task packet's TDD step order and 09617dd restores green, but the range is not bisect-clean.
